name: Jotion
tagline: Connected workspace for wiki, docs, and notes with real-time sync
description:
A full-stack Notion clone built with Next.js 14 and Convex, featuring real-time document editing, nested page trees, cover photos, file uploads via EdgeStore, and instant publishing.

Vibecoded with Cursor and Claude to test how closely a solo developer could match Notion's core UX in a weekend sprint.

replaces.note: Replicates Notion's nested document trees and block editor without the subscription.
